jobs.title: Account Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Boon

Boon is the professional AI platform built specifically for construction. Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2023 by product and engineering leaders from Samsara, Apple, Google and DoorDash. Boon is backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists.

Our AI agents embed directly into existing workflows, from preconstruction estimating to bid management. They automate the repetitive tasks that drain time and margins while surfacing the insights leaders need to make faster and more confident decisions.

The result is measurable impact. Teams move faster, bids are submitted sooner, win rates increase, and costs are reduced. Boon enables construction companies to build more, generate more revenue, and grow with confidence.

About the Role

The Account Development Representative (ADR) job is the launch point for a successful career in SaaS sales. In this role, you will not only be Boon’s customer facing representative but also help shape our go to market strategy as an early stage start up. This includes researching and generating leads, mapping and adding more information to accounts, and creating demand for Boon’s ever expanding set of products and features. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop mid market sales skills and grow rapidly within a well funded startup. Boon provides accelerated commissions and a fast path for promotion into closing roles for high performing ADRs. You will work closely with leadership, influence the product and work with the great talent from companies like Samsara, Doordash, Square among others.

You’re a Great Fit If:

  • You want to make a big difference: your work will have a real impact.

  • You enjoy people: you will be making 100+ calls daily to source prospects 

  • You are naturally curious: the more you know, the more you connect with customers who care about this.

  • You think rejection is a pathway to success:  in this role, you will be told no, a lot during the day. You need to have resilience to keep calling again and again.

  • You're in control of your career here: if you work hard, you will move very fast within Boon, sometimes multiple times within a year. Our team is set up for success, and we have a culture that encourages fast career growth. You'll have lots of chances to try new things and get really good at what you do, in a fast-growing environment.

  • You want to be on a winning team: at Boon, we win together, celebrate together, and help each other out. You'll be part of a great team that pushes you to do your best.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1+ years of sales experience and/or sales prospecting ability, including research on and outreach to new accounts

  • Ability and willingness to make 100+ cold calls a day.

  • A growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process

  • Experience in construction tech is a plus!

Compensation 

At Boon, we want to attract and retain the best employees and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. This estimate can vary based on the above mentioned factors, so the actual starting annual base salary may be above or below this range. A Boon employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company.

Boon Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal-opportunity employer, Boon is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Boon will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Computer Vision, Applied Research Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Boon

Boon is the professional AI platform built specifically for construction. Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2023 by product and engineering leaders from Samsara, Apple, Google and DoorDash. Boon is backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists.

Our AI agents embed directly into existing workflows, from preconstruction estimating to bid management. They automate the repetitive tasks that drain time and margins while surfacing the insights leaders need to make faster and more confident decisions.

The result is measurable impact. Teams move faster, bids are submitted sooner, win rates increase, and costs are reduced. Boon enables construction companies to build more, generate more revenue, and grow with confidence.

About the Role

We are building the first foundation model for construction drawings — a unified multi-modal vision system that reads, understands, and reasons about architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural plans the way a human estimator does.

As a Computer Vision Applied Research Scientist at Boon, you will own end-to-end experiments on our foundation model, from architecture design through self-supervised pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and shipping production models into our inference pipeline.

This is a 80/20 research-to-production role. You will propose new architectures, run the experiments that prove or disprove them, and ship the winning models to real customers. You will have autonomy over direction and experimental ideas, staying aligned with the team and the company's research focus. This is not a role for someone who wants to be told what to build.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12-18 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Push our production model to ≥95% accuracy across multiple trades and scopes

  • Design a genre-defining, novel architecture for construction drawing understanding

  • Publish a paper on the work at a top venue (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR). We're committed to publishing; we may selectively not release weights or code

What You Will Do

Research & Architecture

  • Design and evaluate novel multi-stage vision architectures for construction drawing understanding — perception, text-object association, and relational reasoning across elements

  • Drive architecture decisions: backbones, decoders, fusion strategies, loss functions, training regimes

  • Run rigorous experiments with clean baselines, ablations, and held-out evaluation on real construction drawings

  • Own supervised training and self-supervised pretraining strategies

  • Pursue research directions that compound accuracy across trades and scopes

Production Shipping

  • Take models from experimental notebooks to the production inference pipeline

  • Work hands-on with PyTorch, YOLO, SAM, DINO, and other modern CV stacks

  • Collaborate with ML engineers on deployment, quantization, and serving

  • Debug real failures on real customer drawings and close the loop into the next training run

Cross-Functional Work

  • Collaborate with the synthetic data, annotation, and infrastructure teams to make sure experiments have the data and compute they need

  • Partner with engineering leadership on the accuracy roadmap and strategic direction

  • Write clean internal research reports so the broader team can learn from your work

  • Present findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to engineering leadership

Data & Evaluation

  • Help shape what data we acquire and annotate, based on what the model actually needs

  • Define evaluation datasets and metrics that track progress honestly — not Kaggle-style leaderboard chasing

  • Identify failure modes on real customer drawings and design experiments that address them

You Are a Great Fit If

  • You have 7+ years of computer vision research experience, ideally with a track record of published papers, open-source work, or production CV models

  • You have deep hands-on experience with multi-modal/vision transformers — segmentation, detection, or joint text+vision tasks

  • You have worked with modern vision transformer architectures like SAM, DINO, or similar foundation vision models

  • You can move from a research idea to a trained model to a production-shipped system with minimal hand-holding

  • You think about experiments rigorously — clean baselines, meaningful ablations, honest evaluation on real data

  • You have a point of view on architecture decisions and can defend it with reasoning and experimental evidence

  • You thrive on autonomy and set your own direction while staying aligned with team goals

  • You communicate clearly in English (written and verbal) and can collaborate during California business hours

Requirements

  • 3-7+ years in computer vision research (industry research lab, applied science team, PhD research + industry, or equivalent)

  • Strong track record of published CV research OR trained production CV models that shipped at scale

  • Hands-on expertise in multi-modal dense prediction (segmentation, detection, or joint vision-language tasks)

  • Production experience with modern vision transformer backbones (SAM, DINOv2/v3, CLIP, SigLIP, or similar)

  • Strong PyTorch fluency and experience training large vision models

  • Ability to move models from research to production inference pipelines

  • Strong fundamentals in deep learning: optimization, loss design, regularization, self-supervised learning

  • Fluency in English (written and verbal)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Graph Neural Networks or relational reasoning architectures (we do not expect this — most CV researchers do not — but it is a meaningful plus)

  • Experience with text spotting, OCR, or scene text detection integrated with vision models

  • Experience with LoRA, adapters, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large vision models

  • Experience with self-supervised pretraining (MAE, DINO, or similar)

  • Experience with engineering/technical drawings, document understanding, or layout analysis

  • Contributions to open-source CV research

  • Published papers at top venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR)

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership of research on a problem nobody in construction AI has solved — the first foundation model for construction drawings

  • Autonomy to propose, defend, and run your own experiments, shipping the winners to real customers

  • Publication-friendly — we support our team publishing their work at top venues

  • Work at the intersection of computer vision research and real-world industry impact, in a trillion-dollar market

  • Collaboration with a world-class team from top tech companies and research institutions

  • Meaningful equity in an early-stage, well-funded startup

Compensation

At Boon, we want to attract and retain the best employees and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. This estimate can vary based on the above mentioned factors, so the actual starting annual base salary may be above or below this range. A Boon employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company.

Boon Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal-opportunity employer, Boon is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Boon will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Boon

Boon is the professional AI platform built specifically for construction. Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2023 by product and engineering leaders from Samsara, Apple, Google and DoorDash. Boon is backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists.

Our AI agents embed directly into existing workflows, from preconstruction estimating to bid management. They automate the repetitive tasks that drain time and margins while surfacing the insights leaders need to make faster and more confident decisions.

The result is measurable impact. Teams move faster, bids are submitted sooner, win rates increase, and costs are reduced. Boon enables construction companies to build more, generate more revenue, and grow with confidence.

About the Role

As an Account Executive at Boon, you'll join a small, close-knit team and own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close. You'll be selling AI-powered preconstruction tools — takeoffs, bid leveling, clash detection — to general contractors and subcontractors who are still buried in manual, error-prone estimating work.

In this role, you will:

  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities across general contractors, subcontractors, and specialty trades.

  • Generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, including calls, emails, events, conferences, and online outreach.

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach through close, including demos, proposals, proof of concepts, and negotiations.

  • Partner with estimating and preconstruction teams to understand workflows and position Boon solutions to improve bidding accuracy and efficiency.

  • Manage pipeline health, forecasting, and account strategy to achieve sales goals and maximize growth opportunities.

  • Drive customer expansion and retention by building strong relationships and identifying opportunities across offices, divisions, and teams.

You're a Great Fit If:

  • You want to make a meaningful impact by helping modernize the construction industry and improve how contractors build and bid.

  • You are excited by the opportunity to help bring AI to a large, historically underserved market and contribute to a fast growing company.

  • You enjoy building relationships and are energized by a mix of outbound prospecting and closing.

  • You are naturally curious and enjoy deeply understanding customer pain points and workflows to better solve problems.

  • You are resilient, coachable, and view rejection as part of the process and a pathway to success.

  • You thrive in high growth environments, care deeply about customers, and want strong opportunities for career growth while contributing to a collaborative team culture.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of sales experience, with a track record of success in a quota-carrying capacity.

  • Possess a hunter sales mentality with a strong desire to win, and a proven track record of prospecting, closing new logos, and landing accounts against incumbents.

  • Effective communication skills, including the ability to build rapport, nurture relationships, and deliver compelling presentations.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, competitive, fast-paced startup environment.

  • Tenacity, drive to learn, and a self-motivated attitude.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.

  • Construction, ConTech, or AEC sales experience is a strong plus.

Boon Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal-opportunity employer, Boon is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Boon will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Boon

Boon is the professional AI platform built specifically for construction. Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2023 by product and engineering leaders from Samsara, Apple, Google and DoorDash. Boon is backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists.

Our AI agents embed directly into existing workflows, from preconstruction estimating to bid management. They automate the repetitive tasks that drain time and margins while surfacing the insights leaders need to make faster and more confident decisions.

The result is measurable impact. Teams move faster, bids are submitted sooner, win rates increase, and costs are reduced. Boon enables construction companies to build more, generate more revenue, and grow with confidence.

About the Role

Boon AI is building the agentic operating system for construction preconstruction — the layer that reads blueprints, specs, and bid documents, and does the estimator's work with them. Our platform spans a Rails product monolith, Python computer-vision services (DINOv3/SAM-class vision models reading drawings), an LLM agent runtime orchestrating multi-step construction workflows, and a model/eval infrastructure that keeps accuracy honest. We're live with GCs and subs across the country, shipping daily, and scaling from thousands to hundreds of thousands of drawings per month. The Staff Software Engineer sits across every one of those surfaces and makes sure the system we're building this quarter is the system we can still build on three years from now.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture across the Rails product app, Python ML/CV services, agent SDK layer, and data platform — including the hard tradeoffs between enterprise customer requirements and shipping speed

  • Drive scalability, reliability, and cost architecture of our computer vision/LLM/VLM inference pipelines as we scale blueprint throughput by 100×

  • Set the technical direction for our model infrastructure — vision models, LLM orchestration, agent runtime, MLflow registry, eval harnesses, and GPU budget

  • Lead architectural review, raise the engineering bar through code review and design docs, and lead decisions considering cross-system tradeoffs

  • Mentor senior and junior engineers. Prior engineering management experience a bonus.

  • Partner with the CEO and product on the 12–18 month technical roadmap: what we build in-house, what we buy, what we deprecate, and when to invest in platform vs. features

  • Still write code — this is a working architect role; you'll be in incident response, PR review, and the hardest technical problems on a weekly basis

You’re a Great Fit If:

  • You've shipped production systems that handle messy real-world input — documents, PDFs, images, OCR, user-generated chaos — not just clean API-to-API services

  • You have strong opinions on monolith vs. services, model-in-the-loop UX, when to add complexity, and when "just add another microservice" is the wrong answer

  • You've built or deeply operated computer vision or LLM/agent systems in production, and you understand eval infrastructure as a first-class engineering discipline

  • You move fast without breaking the foundations — comfortable shipping daily, comfortable saying "stop, we need to rebuild this part" and similarly “stop, we should NOT reinvent the wheel and use battle-tested open-source/paid solutions”

  • You thrive in flat, direct, high-velocity teams where the architect sets the technical path and defends it with code and data, not slides

  • Bonus: construction, AEC, or other vertical-SaaS experience; or you've taken a company from Series A to C technically

  • Culturally, you embody working as “one team” and strive to “get things done”, instead of passing the buck around

Requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience building production software, with a track record of delivering in fast-paced, high-growth environments

  • Deep experience with at least two of: large Rails or Python monoliths, computer vision pipelines in production, LLM / agent systems at scale, data-intensive B2B SaaS

  • Hands-on fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP), PostgreSQL at scale, background job systems (RabbitMQ, SideKiq), and modern deployment practices

  • Track record of leading architectural decisions that held up under 10×+ growth

  • Has written and shipped production code in the last 6 months — and plans to keep doing so

  • Familiar with some SRE (Service Reliability) and DevOps - Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD and ability to drive and collaborate with Boon’s dedicated SRE teammates.

Compensation

At Boon, we want to attract and retain the best employees and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. This estimate can vary based on the above mentioned factors, so the actual starting annual base salary may be above or below this range. A Boon employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company.

ABOUT BOON

Boon is the professional AI platform built specifically for construction. Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2023 by product and engineering leaders from Samsara, Apple, Google and DoorDash. Boon is backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists.

Our AI agents embed directly into existing workflows, from preconstruction estimating to bid management. They automate the repetitive tasks that drain time and margins while surfacing the insights leaders need to make faster and more confident decisions.

The result is measurable impact. Teams move faster, bids are submitted sooner, win rates increase, and costs are reduced. Boon enables construction companies to build more, generate more revenue, and grow with confidence.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Boon AI is building the agentic operating system for construction preconstruction — the layer that reads blueprints, specs, and bid documents, and does the estimator's work with them. Our platform spans a Rails product monolith, Python computer-vision services (DINOv3/SAM-class vision models reading drawings), an LLM agent runtime orchestrating multi-step construction workflows, and a model/eval infrastructure that keeps accuracy honest. We're live with GCs and subs across the country, shipping daily, and scaling from thousands to hundreds of thousands of drawings per month. The Staff Software Engineer sits across every one of those surfaces and makes sure the system we're building this quarter is the system we can still build on three years from now.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own the end-to-end technical architecture across the Rails product app, Python ML/CV services, agent SDK layer, and data platform — including the hard tradeoffs between enterprise customer requirements and shipping speed

 - Drive scalability, reliability, and cost architecture of our computer vision/LLM/VLM inference pipelines as we scale blueprint throughput by 100×

 - Set the technical direction for our model infrastructure — vision models, LLM orchestration, agent runtime, MLflow registry, eval harnesses, and GPU budget

 - Lead architectural review, raise the engineering bar through code review and design docs, and lead decisions considering cross-system tradeoffs

 - Mentor senior and junior engineers. Prior engineering management experience a bonus.

 - Partner with the CEO and product on the 12–18 month technical roadmap: what we build in-house, what we buy, what we deprecate, and when to invest in platform vs. features

 - Still write code — this is a working architect role; you'll be in incident response, PR review, and the hardest technical problems on a weekly basis


YOU’RE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You've shipped production systems that handle messy real-world input — documents, PDFs, images, OCR, user-generated chaos — not just clean API-to-API services

 - You have strong opinions on monolith vs. services, model-in-the-loop UX, when to add complexity, and when "just add another microservice" is the wrong answer

 - You've built or deeply operated computer vision or LLM/agent systems in production, and you understand eval infrastructure as a first-class engineering discipline

 - You move fast without breaking the foundations — comfortable shipping daily, comfortable saying "stop, we need to rebuild this part" and similarly “stop, we should NOT reinvent the wheel and use battle-tested open-source/paid solutions”

 - You thrive in flat, direct, high-velocity teams where the architect sets the technical path and defends it with code and data, not slides

 - Bonus: construction, AEC, or other vertical-SaaS experience; or you've taken a company from Series A to C technically

 - Culturally, you embody working as “one team” and strive to “get things done”, instead of passing the buck around


REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE:

 - 8+ years of experience building production software, with a track record of delivering in fast-paced, high-growth environments

 - Deep experience with at least two of: large Rails or Python monoliths, computer vision pipelines in production, LLM / agent systems at scale, data-intensive B2B SaaS

 - Hands-on fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP), PostgreSQL at scale, background job systems (RabbitMQ, SideKiq), and modern deployment practices

 - Track record of leading architectural decisions that held up under 10×+ growth

 - Has written and shipped production code in the last 6 months — and plans to keep doing so

 - Familiar with some SRE (Service Reliability) and DevOps - Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD and ability to drive and collaborate with Boon’s dedicated SRE teammates.




COMPENSATION

At Boon, we want to attract and retain the best employees and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. This estimate can vary based on the above mentioned factors, so the actual starting annual base salary may be above or below this range. A Boon employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company.




BOON IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

All applicants for positions at Boon will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

  • Experience owning features or services from technical design through deployment and ongoing operation

  • Strong coding, debugging, and code review skills, with recent experience shipping production code

  • Familiarity with SRE and DevOps practices, such as CI/CD, Kubernetes, or Helm, and the ability to collaborate with Boon’s dedicated SRE teammates
